tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Returns a runnable example from a FrontMCP docs page: the files of one of its Playgrounds, with their tests, as the docs run them. Without `index`, lists the page's Playgrounds (numbered from 1, in page order) with their section and files.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns a FrontMCP docs page as Markdown, or one section of it. `path` is a path (/reference/sdk/tool), a frontmcp.dev URL, or an old docs.agentfront.dev URL, which is mapped to its page here; a #anchor in it, or `section`, picks the section. A very long page comes back as its introduction and its s

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: FrontMCP's skills catalog (@frontmcp/skills): instructions for building with FrontMCP, from setting up a project to production readiness. Without `name`, lists the skills. With `name`, returns its SKILL.md and the reference files beside it; with `file` too, that file. Skills are step-by-step guides

tools.name: get_versions
tools.description: Lists the FrontMCP releases these docs cover, newest first, each with its release notes and the endpoint that pins it (https://mcp.frontmcp.dev/<version>). Says which version this endpoint serves. To find the version a project uses, call resolve_version.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists the FrontMCP docs as the site's sidebar has them, in reading order: Learn (lessons), Reference (APIs, options, deployment), Examples and Compare, each in groups of pages with their titles and paths. tools.name: lookup_api
tools.description: Finds a FrontMCP API by name in the Reference pages: a decorator (`@Tool`), function or method (`createFetchHandler`, `this.elicit`), option (`inputSchema`, `throttle`), error code (`TOOL_NOT_FOUND`), CLI command or flag (`--target`). tools.name: resolve_version
tools.description: Says which documented FrontMCP version a project should read, and the endpoint that pins it. Pass the project's package.json, its lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml, including relevant importers and all SDK resolutions), or a version range. tools.description: Full-text search over the FrontMCP docs, by section: page titles, section headings and prose.
